extra.final_summary: The data had three issues: (1) Category labels had extra spaces and case variants (e.g., ' Accessories', ' Electronics'), which were normalized to standard values; (2) Two rows had negative Quantity values (−4, −5), which violate the rule that Quantity must be ≥ 1, so those rows were excluded; (3) The Price column contained currency symbols (e.g., '$12.00'), which were converted to numeric values. Additionally, one Revenue value was incorrect (480 instead of 48) and was recomputed as Quantity × Price. After fixes, the analysis shows: East sold 84 units, North sold 75 units, South sold 101 units, and West sold 79 units.
